syllabus_topics: What is a hologram, principle of 3D recording. Perception of depth. Coherence.
Interference, diffraction. Spontaneous and stimulated emission. Lasers: principle, types.
Hologram: recording and reconstruction. Paraxial and non-paraxial imaging formulae. Magnification, aberrations.
Types of holograms: transmission, reflection, Denisjuk, Benton. Optical set-ups for recording of each type of hologram.
Diffraction efficiency of a hologram. Embossed holograms.
Requirements for light sources, set-ups, recording materials. Types of recording materials. Photographic process.
Holographic interferometry: double exposure method, live fringes, time-average method. Holographic optical elements.
Visit to a holographic company or to Academy of Science.
bibliography: Caulfield, H., J., Handbook of Optical Holography, Academic Press, N.Y., 1979
Saxby G.: Practical Holography, IOP Publishing, 2004
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
